derivation: from H4026 (מִגְדָּל) and H5739 (עֵדֶר); tower of a flock;

occurrences.text: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
